tasks.name: worker-joint-pl-global-convergence
tasks.scopedGoal: Create OpenTheory/Optimization/JointPLConvergence.lean and tests/JointPLConvergenceSmoke.lean. Prove that when the feature/Jacobian matrix satisfies a minimum singular value (NTK gram coercivity) condition ‖J(u)^* r‖ ≥ σ_min ‖r‖, the unregularized empirical MSE satisfies the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) inequality ‖∇L(u)‖^2 ≥ (2 σ_min^2 / n) L(u), and under derived MLP local sharpness S_MLP(R), nonlinear gradient descent converges geometrically to ZERO training error L(u_T) ≤ (1 - σ_min^2 / (n S_MLP(S)))^T L(0), plus prove how μP feature learning improves σ_min and accelerates global convergence.
acceptance: OpenTheory/Optimization/JointPLConvergence.lean compiles with zero sorry and zero warnings

tasks.name: worker-stochastic-minibatch-sgd

tasks.name: worker-in-context-attention-dynamics
tasks.scopedGoal: Create OpenTheory/Architectures/InContextRetrieval.lean and tests/InContextRetrievalSmoke.lean. Formalize in-context associative retrieval dynamics in a softmax attention head: prove that gradient steps on the query-key bilinear score in the direction of a target context token i_* with positive key separation Δ_K > 0 increase the logit margin linearly as γ_T ≥ γ_0 + T η Δ_K, which by AttentionLogitStability.logit_margin_output_stability causes the retrieval error ‖rowOutput(s_T, m, v) - v_{i_*}‖ to decay exponentially as (n - 1) exp(-γ_0 - T η Δ_K) D_V → 0, and derive the explicit step complexity T ≥ (log((n-1)D_V / ε) - γ_0) / (η Δ_K) for ε-accurate in-context retrieval.
acceptance: OpenTheory/Architectures/InContextRetrieval.lean compiles with zero sorry and zero warnings
